nodes.description: bool public mintingActive flag in ERC721; gates whether public minting is enabled.
uint256 private totalSupply in OG; counter incremented on every mint and used to derive token ids.
address private _royaltiesReceiver; recipient of ERC2981 royalty payments, mutable by owner.
mapping(address => uint) public artBalance; per-minter counter incremented in mint().
uint256 public constant royaltiesPercentage = 10; used in royaltyInfo calculation.
uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 10; declared maximum supply, never enforced in mint().
mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ogs in ERC721URIStorage; stores number of years of involvement per token.
mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _mintingYear; stores the year supplied at mint time per token.
address private _owner in Ownable; privileged account for onlyOwner functions.
mint(uint256 noYears, uint256 mintingYear) external payable; requires payment, mints, stores metadata and increments totalSupply and artBalance.
withdraw(uint amount) onlyOwner; sends contract balance to msg.sender via transfer().
setMintingActive(bool) public onlyOwner; toggles the mintingActive state variable.
setRoyaltiesReceiver(address) external onlyOwner; updates the royalty recipient address.
royaltyInfo(uint256 _tokenId, uint256 _salePrice) external view; computes royalty as _salePrice * 10 / 100.
tokenURI(uint256) public view override; builds on-chain JSON+base64 metadata using makeArt and stored per-token data.
makeArt(uint256 numberOs, uint256 yearMinted) public view; generates the SVG art based on current year, minting year and number of OGs.
getCurrentYear() public view; returns timestamp2year(block.timestamp), a time-dependent value.
_setOGs(uint256 tokenId, uint256 _ogsPassed) internal; writes the _ogs mapping.
_setMintingYear(uint256 tokenId, uint256 _whenMinted) internal; writes the _mintingYear mapping.
_safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal; mints and then calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
_transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal; moves ownership and updates balances.
_checkOnERC721Received(address,address,uint256,bytes) private; performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) internal; forwards all gas with recipient.call{value: amount}("").
Address.functionCallWithValue(...) internal; performs target.call{value: value}(data) after an isContract check.
_mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal; writes _balances and _owners after existence checks.
owner() public view; returns the stored _owner address.
modifier onlyOwner(); requires owner() == _msgSender(), the access-control guard of the contract.
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used in mint, withdraw and the onlyOwner check.
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time source consumed by getCurrentYear.
payable(someone).transfer(amount) inside withdraw(); sends ETH to msg.sender after the balance check.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue; low-level ETH send forwarding all gas to an arbitrary address.
target.call{value: value}(data) inside Address.functionCallWithValue; arbitrary external call with value.
IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(...) external call in _checkOnERC721Received; invokes untrusted recipient code during mint/transfer.
uint256 noYears parameter of mint(); stored as the token's OG count.
uint256 mintingYear parameter of mint(); stored as the token's minting year.
uint amount parameter of withdraw(); amount of wei to send to the caller.
address newRoyaltiesReceiver parameter of setRoyaltiesReceiver().
bool isMintingActive parameter of setMintingActive().
uint256 _salePrice parameter of royaltyInfo(); multiplied by royaltiesPercentage.
uint256 tokenId parameter of tokenURI(); indexes _ogs and _mintingYear.
address someone = msg.sender local variable inside withdraw(), used as the transfer recipient.
uint256 numberOs parameter of makeArt(); number of OGs owned.
uint256 yearMinted parameter of makeArt(); year the token was minted.
uint256 yearAdjust local variable in makeArt(); getCurrentYear() - yearMinted.

edges.reason: mint() reads mintingActive (together with msg.sender == owner()) to decide whether minting is allowed.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and is checked against owner() when minting is paused.
mint() computes totalSupply+1 for the token id and then increments totalSupply.
mint() increments artBalance[msg.sender] by one.
mint() calls _safeMint before updating totalSupply and artBalance, opening a state-inconsistency window.
mint() calls _setOGs(totalSupply+1, noYears).
mint() calls _setMintingYear(totalSupply+1, mintingYear).
noYears parameter flows into the _ogs storage mapping via _setOGs.
mintingYear parameter flows into the _mintingYear storage mapping via _setMintingYear.
withdraw() derives the ETH recipient from msg.sender (address someone = msg.sender).
the amount parameter controls how much ETH withdraw() sends.
withdraw() performs an external ETH transfer to the caller.
the local someone variable is the recipient of the payable transfer.
onlyOwner guards withdraw(), restricting it to the owner.
onlyOwner guards setMintingActive().
onlyOwner guards setRoyaltiesReceiver().
the onlyOwner modifier compares owner() against _msgSender().
the isMintingActive parameter directly overwrites the mintingActive flag.
setMintingActive() writes the mintingActive state variable.
newRoyaltiesReceiver parameter flows into _royaltiesReceiver.
setRoyaltiesReceiver() writes the privileged _royaltiesReceiver address.
royaltyInfo() multiplies _salePrice by royaltiesPercentage and divides by 100.
royaltiesPercentage constant participates in the royalty computation.
royaltyInfo() returns _royaltiesReceiver as the payment receiver.
the tokenId parameter selects the _ogs and _mintingYear entries used for metadata.
tokenURI() calls makeArt(_ogs[tokenId], _mintingYear[tokenId]).
tokenURI() reads the _ogs mapping for the requested token.
tokenURI() reads the _mintingYear mapping for the requested token.
makeArt() calls getCurrentYear() to compute yearAdjust and score.
getCurrentYear() derives its result from block.timestamp, making art output time/miner dependent.
numberOs is added to yearAdjust in makeArt's branching and score computation.
yearMinted is subtracted from the current year and from numberOs inside makeArt.
yearAdjust = getCurrentYear() - yearMinted is used throughout makeArt.
_safeMint() calls _mint() before the receiver callback.
_safeMint() calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient after state changes.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes untrusted onERC721Received code on the recipient contract, enabling reentrancy into mint/transfer entry points.
mint() reaches the untrusted ERC721 receiver callback through _safeMint while totalSupply and artBalance are still un-updated.
Address.sendValue performs a low-level value call with all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
Address.functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary external call forwarding value and gas.

normalization_plan.reason: noYears is a mint() argument that is immediately stored into the _ogs mapping by _setOGs and has no independent role.
mintingYear is a mint() argument that is immediately stored into the _mintingYear mapping by _setMintingYear.
amount is only consumed by withdraw() as the ETH value to transfer and carries no separate semantics.
the parameter solely provides the new value written to _royaltiesReceiver inside setRoyaltiesReceiver().
the boolean parameter is a direct alias of the mintingActive flag written by setMintingActive().
_salePrice is only used inside royaltyInfo() for the arithmetic royalty computation.
tokenId is only used to index _ogs/_mintingYear while building the URI in tokenURI().
someone is assigned msg.sender and exists only to be the recipient of payable(someone).transfer(amount).
numberOs is used only as an input term of the SVG-generation arithmetic inside makeArt().
yearMinted is used only inside makeArt() to compute yearAdjust and score.
yearAdjust is a temporary scratch value inside makeArt() with no lifetime beyond the call.
